name: Gnome
description: Gnomes are magical, inventive folk whose cleverness helped them thrive in forests and underground homes. Their forest and rock lineages express that ancient magic in different ways.

grants.name: Darkvision
grants.description: You have Darkvision out to 60 feet.

grants.name: Gnomish Cunning
grants.description: You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

grants.name: Gnomish Lineage
grants.description: Choose the supernatural lineage your gnome inherits.

options.name: Forest Gnome
options.description: You know Minor Illusion and always have Speak with Animals prepared. Cast Speak with Animals without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest, or use spell slots.

options.name: Rock Gnome
options.description: You know Mending and Prestidigitation. A 10-minute Prestidigitation casting can create a Tiny clockwork device that reproduces one effect of the spell; up to three can exist, each lasting 8 hours.

grants.name: Lineage Spellcasting Ability
grants.description: Choose the spellcasting ability used by your Gnomish Lineage spells.
